model_full_name: Adaptive Calibrated Tri-Expert Network for Pharmacological Entity Recognition
authorization: New fold-specific comparator copies authorized; all historical artifacts preserved
historical_test: Post-hoc Diagnostic Test; never used by this development experiment
reserve: 191 relation-task test documents; eligibility and untouched status not yet certified; labels remain sealed
primary_estimand: Corpus micro Strict Typed Entity F1 on outer held-out documents
grouping: Connected components of documents sharing normalized exact sentences of at least 40 characters and 6 words; all sentences in every document retained

transformer.initialization: Original pretrained weights, never the historical fine-tuned checkpoint
transformer.precision: float32 on MPS; CUDA autocast only if implemented and validated
transformer.unfreezing: all layers; shared fixed expert budget for all ACT configurations

candidate_policy: Union of both experts, marginal runs and +/-1-token corrections; exact deduplication only; no anchor acceptance override
lexicon_policy: Fold-training only; reliability features never generate candidates

calibration.isotonic: deferred unless each calibration fold has at least 100 positives and 100 negatives

inactive_component_policy: Do not claim a no-op as an ablation. Continual adaptation is a separate future shift experiment, not part of frozen primary inference. Calibration and early-exit equivalence controls may produce identical predictive outputs and must be labeled accordingly.
inner_role_policy: Head-training documents alone generate three-fold cross-fitted expert evidence. Head-selection documents are excluded from every upstream fit and early-stop set. Final upstream experts fit only head-training documents, with their own grouped internal early-stop set. Calibration and outer documents are excluded from every fit/selection role.
ablation_tuning_policy: Fix jointly selected full-model hyperparameters; refit each single-mechanism ablation on identical role memberships and seeds, selecting its epoch and threshold on the same inner selection documents. Architecture comparisons are paired on outer documents.
pooling: Entity-probability-weighted attention pooling over frozen contextual tokens; pooling weights are not trainable. The span projection and low-rank residual adapter are trainable; no claim of Transformer-layer LoRA is made.
consistency: No confidence calibration or continual-adaptation loss during primary predictive training

statistics.secondary_estimand: Paired component-level F1 difference and Wilcoxon, separate from corpus micro-F1
statistics.repeated_run_policy: Resample each component jointly across all repeats and seeds; repeated predictions are not independent documents

superiority_rule: Positive paired interval and Holm-adjusted evidence with effect size; report null or adverse results without additional test-driven tuning
confirmatory_access: Explicit separate freeze seal required before any reserve label read or test inference
immutable_outputs: Content-addressed protocol and membership; resume only complete matching runs, never historical result caches
